items.quote: Der Betrag ist binnen 4 Tagen, das heißt bis spätestens 11.04.2025, auf das Sonderkonto IBAN SK20 1100 0000 0029 4512 3456 (Empfänger: R. Horváth, Verwendungszweck ZFB-25-0407-118) zu überweisen.
items.computation: Letter dated 07.04.2025; 4 days counted from 07.04 ends 11.04.2025, which matches the printed date. 11.04.2025 is a Friday, not a holiday. Printed calendar date used as written. The sender is a private collector, not an authority, so no deemed-delivery rule applies.

warnings: Strong scam indicators: a 4-day deadline, a threat of wage garnishment and credit bureau entries, and a claim that objections will no longer be handled.
The payee is a private person (R. Horváth) with a Slovak IBAN (SK) on a 'Sonderkonto', which does not match the company named in the letterhead.

The letter says an 'Vollstreckungsbescheid' will be applied for without warning. Real collectors cannot enforce without a court title, and a genuine Mahnbescheid or court document would carry a statutory objection period.
The salutation is generic ('Sehr geehrter Schuldner'), and there is no itemised legal basis for the collection costs of 96.00 and 22.80 EUR.

Do not pay. Check whether you ever had this subscription, and consider asking the consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale) or reporting it to the police. If the claim is real, you can dispute it in writing.
The letter's own date (07.04.2025) is long past today's date (2026-09-30), so the stated deadline has already expired.
Note: the deadline 11.04.2025 has no legal effect if the claim is not genuine.
